about: Ledge kills (the owner, 15 Nov: knocked off the edge = dead, loot at the ledge; elites and bosses stop at the brink). Read by logic/Maps/LedgeEdges.cs (edges, kinds) and src/Actors/CrowdView.cs + src/Fx/BattleFx.cs (fall, brink). EDGES: which of a dungeon's edges are a drop, by the kind of edge, as the play camera sees it (src/World/DungeonWalls.cs Ctx.HLoc builds them so): hole = a hole or pit in a room's floor (holeGap: a cell is a hole's when HoleField - WallField is under it; the den's WallOnly parts them at 1.775, the ravine's at 0); near = a wall whose outside faces the lens (+z); side = one facing sideways; backOpen = a back wall with walkable ground within openProbe metres behind it (the ravine drops these too); back = the back wall with rock behind it. A dungeon named here drops at the kinds in its list and stops a foe at the rest; a dungeon not named drops nowhere (a new dungeon's walls stop foes until its look says). KINDS: the view's own thresholds, at their midpoints (near Sm(0.3,0.65) of the outward normal's z; side Sm(0.45,0.8) of |x|; open Sm(10,16) of how far the wall runs on behind). FALL (CrowdView, a foe with Enemy.Fell): carried on past the lip at least carry metres a metre of its size over the first carryT seconds, tipping over along the push (flipDeg for a light body, dragDeg for a heavy one: mass lightMass and under is light, heavyMass and over heavy, between eased; a heavy body's tip and drop start later by heavyLag), dropping from dropAt with gravity g, shrinking to shrinkTo and darkening to darkTo, gone by the end of DieTime (dissolve over the last fadeT). BRINK (an elite or a boss stopped at the brink): leans back from the drop leanDeg, eased in over leanIn and out over leanOut; dust at the lip on both.
